text:
Priya: Quick update 1: were opening a small beta for a new Dedicated pool class: GH200-optimized (memory-partitioned GH200 nodes) in two zones: us-west2-a and ap-south1-b. Rolling now. :sparkles:
Priya: Why GH200-optimized? customers running very large context models have asked for more memory and model-parallel-friendly nodes. These pools expose memory partitioning to the runtime for larger KV caches and longer seq lengths.

Liam: Deploy notes: initial capacity is limited (per-org default 4 GPUs). This is deliberate 1 to gather perf signals and avoid noisy neighbors. Were enabling Reserved + Dedicated burst attach, not ephemeral shared.

Sasha: Compliance note: GH200-optimized pools are supported for Dedicated reservations with standard data-at-rest encryption. However, GH200 instances are not yet available in Private (VPC) images during beta. If you need VPC, file an escalation to infra-security.

Priya: Policy changes (effective now):
- Per-org default GH200-optimized reserved limit: 4 GPUs.
- Per-org burst attach cap: 1 GPU-equivalent.
- Minimum commit for GH200-reserved: 7 days.
- Overage billing: burst attach beyond cap billed at premium rate; first 24h of burst usage for beta is waived.

Carlos: Pricing (beta guidance): ballpark per-GPU/hr: GH200-optimized ~ $0.85/hr, H200 ~ $1.10/hr, A100x ~ $2.50/hr. Final pricing pending GA.

capacity-bot: Capacity summary: us-west2-a: 6 GH200 nodes available for beta whitelist. ap-south1-b: 3 nodes available. Reservations accepted via API/console until stock exhausted.

deploy-bot: Canary checks passed in us-west2-a. All infra health checks green.

Liam: SRE expectations: target P95 for long-context decoding workloads ~ 350600ms depending on model size and seq len. Watch batch growth and memory pressure metrics. If swap or OOM rate >0 for >1m, auto-drain will kick in.

ops-oncall: Ive added GH200 dashboards (memory-partitioning utilization, OOM/sec, KV cache hit rate). Alerting: page if OOM/sec > 0 for >30s or if average batch size > 12 for >10m. Ill monitor the first 48 hours.

Priya: CLI example to reserve (beta whitelist required):
```
redwoodctl dedicated reserve --pool gh200-optimized --zone us-west2-a --count 2 --duration 14d --billing-acct ACCT-999
```

Sasha: Note for Sales/CS: please do not promise VPC for GH200-optimized until we confirm Private images. Use language: "Dedicated-only beta, VPC to follow". CS template: internal/documents/gh200-beta-cs.md

Carlos: Action items:
- Eng-runtime: collect memory-partition telemetry and publish perf summary by EOD+3.
- Infra: prepare Private image timeline (target 6 weeks).
- CS/Sales: start whitelist invites, use beta one-pager.
- Docs: publish beta FAQ + migration notes.

Priya: Deprecation note: No deprecations tied to this launch. Existing H200/A100 families unaffected.

Liam: Heads-up: there will be a short maintenance window in ap-south1-b at 03:300:30 UTC to finalize firmware for GH200 nodes. Expect brief reservation API flaps (~2-3m). Well post in #eng-oncall.

Priya: Thanks all. Ping me or @ops-oncall for emergencies. Internal GH200 doc: https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/dedicated/gh200-beta (internal). :rocket:
